actual: The formal HMM G2-A v1.6 single-date consumer passes a short stock-history calendar into the Qlib Bin reader, while each .day.bin start index is relative to the full release calendar. A valid 2026-08-28 as-of / 2026-08-31 decision request therefore fails closed before consumer preflight. Fix the calendar/bin-index boundary without changing model, mapping, data, tail, or runtime semantics; add Windows and WSL fresh-process regression evidence.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
